decisions.summary: The grove is the precinct: a near-rectangle filling the sheet's frame, about 117 ft wide from the shrine well at its back edge to the outermost arch (about 225 ft), about 730 tsubo by the plan's arithmetic, measured at T-map; the round-2 'trimmed if above 650' dropped; the band T-program writes is R2's register figures as found (Saitama 55-708, Tochigi 142-2,700, Saga unranked 50-662, with their medians), never widened to fit
decisions.why: FR-007 fixes the grove's reach (every side of hall and sanctuary; back to the well; forward to the outermost arch) and requires its area inside 'the register band FR-005 records', and FR-005 says only 'restated from the register figures (accurate as a band)' - neither the spec nor the GM's words set 650 as a cap; '150-650 typical' is the session's summary line (roughly the span of the three medians), not a register figure and not a GM ruling. SC-002 (bare ground only as a border no deeper than the crop margin, over the WHOLE rectangular frame) makes a grove that narrows along the avenue fail, so a near-rectangle is the spec's own consequence, not a carve-out. Measured on the manifest (2 ft/px): well y=1020, hall center y=1074 (48 ft deep), front face y=1086; at the 12 ft pitch the outermost arch is at y=1128, so well-to-outermost-arch is 216 ft, and 117 by 216-225 ft is about 710-740 tsubo, inside Tochigi's 142-2,700 register (median 655, mean 817) - an ordinary village-shrine precinct by the research, and the grove the GM ruled for. Condition, not a narrowing: T-program must record the register figures (ranges and medians) as the band, and no text may call the grove 'typical' or 'inside 150-650'. Correction owed: research.md D6a says 730 is 'below Tochigi's upper half' - it is above Tochigi's median (655), i.e. IN its upper half, between median and mean; the ruling does not rest on that phrase, but it must not reach the record or the notes as written

decisions.summary: The sacred tree stands beside the approach, inside the grove

The revision seats it by the GM's own words ('the sacred tree and a stone basin by the approach') and FR-007/US2 ('a sacred tree and a stone basin beside the approach'), a placement every reading of the ruling accepts. No longer a narrowing
